prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1389; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a rear-end collision that occurred while our client was lawfully stopped in traffic. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter, including requests for statements, recorded or otherwise, to this office rather than to our client.

We request that you disclose the full bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please provide this information in writing as soon as possible.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair estimates, telephone and recorded statements, and any surveillance or dashcam footage. Please ensure that no materials are altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
